format: pmtiles: one archive of Terrarium-encoded PNG raster-dem tiles, z5-11, 256 px

upstream.notes: USGS 3DEP 1 arc-second seamless DEM, 1x1 degree GeoTIFFs from https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/1/TIFF/current/ (202 cells including one ring of neighbours, ~8,177 MB for Texas). Built with --source 1: z12 pixels are ~30 m anyway, and the 1/3 arc-second product is ~9x the download. Quarterly at most; a rebuild is a deliberate workflow_dispatch. TNM Access API: https://tnmaccess.nationalmap.gov/api/v1/products

notes: Rebuilt 2026-11-10 with one ring of neighbouring 3DEP cells (build_topo.py CELL_RING) so edge tiles have real terrain past the bbox: 759,368,379 bytes, sha256 495dd5aad2d65c986232d418e5cbe68b199fd9feae1e919426ff34ac39c31d96. Interior tiles are byte-identical to the previous build; 33 edge tiles changed. maxzoom 11, not 12: at z12 the Texas archive was 2,692,276,029 bytes (28,957 tiles), over GitHub's 2 GiB per-asset limit, so it is built with --maxzoom 11 (7,364 tiles, ~65 m pixels; the phone overzooms z11 for z12+). One file: elevation only, as Terrarium raster-dem (height_m = R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768; sea and no-data 0 m). Contours and hillshade are drawn on the phone from these tiles, so there is no separate vector-contour or hillshade pack. Builder needs no GDAL or tippecanoe (numpy, tifffile, imagecodecs, Pillow, pmtiles).
